info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Aisp By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Access Consent Management API enables organizations to efficiently manage account access consents related to open banking services. This endpoint allows for the deletion of a specific account access consent identified by a unique parameter. Typically utilized by financial institutions and third-party providers, this API supports compliance with regulations and enhances security by giving users control over their consent preferences. Use cases include revoking access for specific applications or services as part of user account management.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to revoke a previously granted account access consent identified by the specific resource ID. Successfully executing this operation will prevent any further access to the account data covered by this consent.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete the account access consent for a specified resource ID. Ensure that the correct resource ID is provided to avoid unintended deletions.

204.description: Request successfully completed with no content to return.

DeleteAispByParam1Request.title: Account Access Consent Deletion Request Body
DeleteAispByParam1Request.description: The request body for deleting account access consents. It is expected to be a string that may contain contextual information.

DeleteAispByParam1Response_204.description: The response schema for a successful deletion of an account access consent. This schema provides metadata about the deletion operation.
